The agent never got Teal'c's reply, and the clearest wrong turn is at step 7.

After the caption API failed at step 6, the agent could have used `yt-dlp` to pull subtitles directly, since `yt-dlp` was already working. Instead it switched to extracting audio with `ffmpeg`, which was not installed. It also ran `pip install ffmpeg`, which is the wrong package. It named no transcription tool for the audio either.

Earlier steps also went wrong, with an undefined function at step 1 and an unsubscribed API at step 5. Both were recoverable, so I do not count them as decisive.
